controls.name: overlap_ignores_wrong_label
controls.implication: Geometry can identify a semantically wrong control at full L=1.

controls.name: distant_text_match
controls.implication: An arbitrarily displaced matching label can earn L=0.1.

controls.name: generic_noop
controls.implication: No-op functional clicks can get B=0.5, hence S=0.5 at L=1.

controls.name: wrong_destination
controls.implication: A content change is sufficient without destination validation.

controls.name: empty_destination
controls.implication: Empty/destroyed body can be treated as successful navigation.

controls.name: navigation_noop_control
controls.implication: Unchanged word sets fail the navigation test.

controls.name: cosmetic_toggle
controls.implication: A cosmetic class change can satisfy toggle behavior.

controls.name: internal_absolute_external
controls.implication: Absolute internal links pass the external-link test.

controls.name: hidden_dialog_count
controls.implication: The count probe has no visibility/content/focus requirement.

controls.name: distant_testid_anchor
controls.implication: Curated testid match returns score=1 despite a >2,000px displacement; main short-circuits to tier 1.

controls.name: critical_music_click
controls.implication: The generic music probe affects the headline denominator.

controls.name: unknown_navigation_bonus
controls.implication: Bonus annotations do not affect critical S.

controls.name: inspect_mean_of_products
controls.implication: mean(L*B)=0, while mean(L)*mean(B)=0.25; aggregation must preserve pairing.

published_arithmetic.limitation: Arithmetic verified from published artifacts; no independent browser rescore or agent rerun.
